Former contractor Tony Aguilar answers his critics in this Tucker Carlson episode about the war in Gaza. Aguilar worked with the aid effort in Gaza and came forward with claims of war crimes at food distribution sites. His account drew fierce attacks, and here he responds in his own words.

Aguilar describes what he says he saw while guarding aid deliveries under fire. He names the events and dates he wants investigated. Carlson asks how he has been treated since speaking out and what proof he can offer. Brave and principled viewers hear a soldier's stand, defended at length on camera.
